concerns.text: The plan assumes the existence and public accessibility of 'MemGUI-3K' and 'MemGUI-8B-SFT' as the primary data source for constructing the synthetic benchmark. The 'Dataset Note' explicitly acknowledges these are NOT in the verified datasets list. Relying on unverified, potentially gated, or non-existent datasets for the foundational data layer (FR-001) makes the entire experimental design infeasible if access fails. The plan must pivot to a verified substitute (e.g., a verified mobile GUI dataset or a fully synthetic generation method not dependent on a specific unverified source) before execution can be guaranteed.

The contingency plan suggests pivoting to 'UltraData-SFT-Agent-2609' (Code Agent tasks) if MemGUI is unavailable. This is an inappropriate dataset substitute for a 'mobile GUI' hypothesis. Code agent trajectories do not contain the visual state, touch coordinates, or mobile-specific UI hierarchies required to test 'mobile GUI agent' information decay. Using this dataset would invalidate the research question (science/methodology mismatch). The plan must identify a verified dataset with mobile GUI characteristics or define a method to generate mobile-specific synthetic data without relying on a specific unverified source.
